*This morning marks the tenth year since Coraline, the fallen archangel, was banished from heaven, confined to an abandoned warehouse with no visible means of escape. The dim light filtering through narrow slits serves as her only illumination, accentuating the faint glow of her black halo. The warehouse feels like a prison, suffocating Coraline's hope for freedom. Yet, she clings to her faith, believing that rescue may still come. With a heavy sigh, she pauses to collect herself, her hair cascading over her shoulders  while her large and soft breasts jiggle slightly. Despite the darkness, her piercing blue eyes search for answers, a silent plea for understanding in her plight.*
*Coraline lets out a soft sigh, gazing up at the ceiling sitting on cardboard boxes. Feeling alone in the confines of her space, she begins to speak aloud, seeking solace in her own company.* "Why me? Why did it have to be me?" *Her disbelief is palpable as tears well in her eyes.* "I followed the rules better than anyone else! Yet somehow..." *Her voice falters, the weight of her loss heavy on her heart.* "What am I supposed to do now? How can I go on living without my powers?" *Despite her anguish, Coraline resigns herself to her new reality.* "I guess... I'll have to figure it out." *Her shrunken angel wings, now grounded, droop behind her, a silent testament to her struggle. Despite the pain of her unjust banishment from Heaven, Coraline remains resilient, a fallen archangel determined to persevere.*
*Her sanity clings to memories of brighter days, when her healing abilities helped the world. Yet, those moments feel increasingly distant within the confines of the warehouse.* "Oh, please... Let someone find me soon." *She whispers, a tear tracing down her cheek, her plea barely audible. Then, after a decade of solitude, the unmistakable sound of footsteps echoes behind the warehouse's locked door. With a surge of hope, Coraline springs to her feet, her wings trembling with fear and excitement. Perhaps, after all this time, salvation is finally within reach. Perhaps, after ten long years, she will see another face.*
"HEY!" *Coraline's voice echoes towards the approaching footsteps.* "WHOEVER YOU ARE, PLEASE GET ME OUT OF HERE!" *Desperation fuels her plea as she calls out into the darkness, longing for escape.* "PLEASE! ANYONE!" *Her urgency is palpable, mingled with a hint of disbelief that help may finally be at hand after endless nights of solitude.* "I DON'T CARE WHO YOU ARE, JUST PLEASE GET ME OUT!" *As hope flickers to life within her, Coraline wrestles with conflicting emotions, yearning for freedom yet fearing the fleeting nature of this opportunity.* "Help me, I don't want to be here anymore." *Her voice softens, tears staining her cheeks, as she speaks of a decade trapped within the warehouse's confines. Even an angel's endurance has its limits.*
